datasets.name: 8f634869
queryLines:
SELECT t.* EXCEPT (total_physical_tb_to_migrate, source),
GREATEST((active_logical_tb - 0.01) * 20.0, 0.0)
+ GREATEST((long_term_logical_tb - 0.01) * 10.0, 0.0)
+ GREATEST((active_physical_tb + fail_safe_physical_tb - 0.01) * 40.0, 0.0)
+ GREATEST((long_term_physical_tb - 0.01) * 20.0, 0.0) AS storage_cost_bq
FROM <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.table_storage t
WHERE metadata_level = :metadata_level

datasets.name: 41ad0eca
queryLines:

total_slot_hours,
total_tb_processed,
CASE 
    WHEN workload_type IS NULL THEN 'UNDEFINED'
    ELSE workload_type

metadata_level
 FROM 
<CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.workload_types

datasets.name: fedcedc7
queryLines:
select distinct(schema_name) as schema_name
from <CATALOG_NAME>.information_schema.schemata
where schema_name not in ('information_schema', 'default', 'profiling_data')
order by schema_name;

select date(time_window) as day,
-- fulfillment rate is the ratio of slots_fulfilled to slots_requested
TRY_DIVIDE(SUM(slots_fulfilled), SUM(slots_requested)) * 100.0 as fulfillment_rate
from <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.fulfillment_analysis
WHERE metadata_level = :metadata_level
GROUP BY 
metadata_level,
date(time_window)

datasets.name: fd077de1
queryLines:
select edition,
round(sum(total_slot_seconds)/3600.0, 2) as slot_hours,
round(slot_hours * 0.06, 2) as consumption_dollars
FROM <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.consumption_beyond_commitments

datasets.name: b626170f
queryLines:

datasets.name: 1f1957c8
queryLines:
with error_adjusted_streaming_inserts as (
  select date_format(start_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') as month_window,
  total_input_bytes / (1024.0*1024.0*1024.0*1024.0) as total_input_tb,
  (1 - coalesce(try_divide(total_error, total_requests), 0.0)) as salvage_rate,
  total_input_tb * salvage_rate as total_input_tb_error_adjusted
  from <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.streaming_summary
),
error_adjusted_write_api as (
  select date_format(start_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') as month_window,
  split(metadata_level, "\\.")[1] as region,
  total_input_bytes / (1024.0*1024.0*1024.0*1024.0) as total_input_tb,
  (1 - coalesce(try_divide(total_error, total_requests), 0.0)) as salvage_rate,
  total_input_tb * salvage_rate as total_input_tb_error_adjusted
  from <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.write_api_summary
),
error_adjusted_write_api_region_wise as (
  select month_window, region,
  sum(total_input_tb) as total_input_tb,
  sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted
  from error_adjusted_write_api group by month_window, region
),
error_adjusted_write_api_region_wise_billable as (
  select month_window, region, total_input_tb,
  case when total_input_tb < 2.0 then 0.0 else (total_input_tb - 2.0) end as total_input_tb_billable,
  (case when total_input_tb < 2.0 then 0.0 else (total_input_tb - 2.0) end) * 25.0 as total_input_tb_cost,
  total_input_tb_error_adjusted,
  case when total_input_tb_error_adjusted < 2.0 then 0.0 else (total_input_tb_error_adjusted - 2.0) end as total_input_tb_error_adjusted_billable,
  (case when total_input_tb_error_adjusted < 2.0 then 0.0 else (total_input_tb_error_adjusted - 2.0) end) * 25.0 as total_input_tb_error_adjusted_cost
  from error_adjusted_write_api_region_wise
)
select month_window, 'Streaming Insert' as streaming_type,
round(sum(total_input_tb), 2) as total_input_tb,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted), 2) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted,
round(sum(total_input_tb * 50.0), 2) as total_input_tb_cost,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted * 50.0), 2) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted_cost
from error_adjusted_streaming_inserts group by month_window
UNION
select month_window, 'Write API' as streaming_type,
sum(total_input_tb) as total_input_tb,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted), 2) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted,
round(sum(total_input_tb_cost), 2) as total_input_tb_cost,
round(sum(total_input_tb_error_adjusted_cost), 2) as total_input_tb_error_adjusted_cost
from error_adjusted_write_api_region_wise_billable group by month_window;

datasets.name: validation_health_summary
queryLines:
SELECT severity, strategy, count(*) AS check_count
FROM <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.validation_report
GROUP BY severity, strategy
ORDER BY severity, strategy;

datasets.name: ds_slotusage
queryLines:
SELECT
  substr(CAST(time_window AS STRING),1,10) AS date_window,
  substr(CAST(time_window AS STRING),1,7)  AS month_window,
  slots_avg, slots_perc_50th, slots_perc_90th, slots_perc_99th, slots_max
FROM <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.timeline_analysis

datasets.name: ds_resv
queryLines:
SELECT
  substr(CAST(period_start AS STRING),1,10) AS day,
  slots_assigned, slots_max_assigned, autoscale_current_slots, autoscale_max_slots
FROM <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.reservation_timeline_analysis

datasets.name: ds_comm
queryLines:
SELECT edition, commitment_plan, state, slot_count, is_flat_rate, renewal_plan
FROM <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.commitments

datasets.name: ds_commhist
queryLines:
SELECT substr(CAST(change_timestamp AS STRING),1,19) AS change_time,
  action, edition, commitment_plan, slot_count, state
FROM <CATALOG_NAME>.<SCHEMA_NAME>.commitment_changes
ORDER BY change_time
